name: P-004 root SU turn-start HTTP receipt and confirmed cursor
command: Inside the disposable host: coord:declare-intent, mode:set auto, POST /api/agent-mcp/turn-start-memory with confirmedDelivery:null, read orientation cursor, echo the returned token in a second POST, then read the committed cursor receipt
summary: The isolated current-build turn-start endpoint returned nonempty orientation text and a delivery token. Its pending identityComponentDeliveryV1 receipt bound the root SU mode and assignment contributions from the declared producers; echoing the received token promoted the same bound root receipt to the committed cursor. The assertion command and verifier teardown exited 0.

assertions.evidence: The first native POST returned ok:true, nonempty text with SHA-256 4c92617f1d22fcc5510d2d8979b88c449b8d8feee209812ea2869dac2a2b9086, and a nonempty deliveryToken. Mode AUTO and presence intent were recorded first in the disposable workspace.

Pending orientation cursor identityComponentDeliveryV1 status=bound; root.identityId=su, sourceRevision=f4d612298e67e1b280e0c71f81e2baff45c83dfc7e03d394f25e2e2d86930282, current-mode-state producerRef=modes/store:agent_modes, current-assignment producerRef=coord:presence.

The second native POST echoed the exact received deliveryToken. The committed orientation cursor then held status=bound, the same token and the same root source revision; no pending-only receipt was mistaken for confirmed delivery.

operatorPlane: isolated current-build turn-start HTTP endpoint and disposable migrated PostgreSQL cursor
limitation: The assertion script received the block and confirmed its token; it did not run an LLM model turn. This is current-build native hook evidence, not deployed main, rollback, fleet/GOAL replacement, or final P-008 acceptance. The disposable host and database were torn down after the check.
